name: contact-form
title: Contact form
description: A developer tool's contact card: pitch, reply times and a customer quote beside a labelled form with topic chips.
author: themes.dev

files.content:
import { ArrowRight, Clock, LifeBuoy, MessageSquareText, Users } from "lucide-react" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/components/ui/avatar" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input" import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label" import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea" export type ImageRef = { src: string; alt: string; width: number; height: number } export type LinkRef = { label: string; href: string } export type Channel = { label: string; value: string; note: string } export type Testimonial = { quote: string; name: string; role: string; photo: ImageRef } export type FieldText = { label: string; placeholder: string } export type ContactFormProps = { kicker: string title: string body: string channels: Channel[] testimonial: Testimonial form: { title: string action: string reasonsLabel: string reasons: string[] submit: string consent: string privacy: LinkRef /** The email field. Defaults to "Work email", you@example.com. */ email?: FieldText /** The message field. Defaults to "How can we help?" with a developer prompt as placeholder. */ message?: FieldText } } const defaultEmail: FieldText = { label: "Work email", placeholder: "you@example.com" } const defaultMessage: FieldText = { label: "How can we help?", placeholder: "Your stack, the size of your database, what you are trying to do" } export const contactFormDefaults: ContactFormProps = { kicker: "Sales and support", title: "Talk to the engineers who build Quaywire", body: "Pricing for a large cluster, a demo on your own schema or a query plan that looks wrong: the message goes to our team in Amsterdam, not to a ticket queue.", channels: [ { label: "Sales", value: "Within 4 working hours", note: "Mon to Fri, 08:00 to 18:00 CET" }, { label: "Support on paid plans", value: "Within 1 hour", note: "Around the clock for Scale customers" }, ], testimonial: { quote: "We put a GraphQL API on 340 Postgres tables in an afternoon. Their engineer stayed on the call until our first production query came back in 12 ms.", name: "Joris Verbeek", role: "Platform lead, Pakketpunt", photo: { src: "https://www.themes.dev/ui/photos/contact-form/quote.webp", alt: "Joris Verbeek", width: 112, height: 112 }, }, form: { title: "Send us a message", action: "/contact", reasonsLabel: "What is it about?", reasons: ["Pricing", "A demo", "Technical support", "Something else"], submit: "Send message", consent: "We use your details only to answer this message and, if you ask for it, to follow up about Quaywire.", privacy: { label: "Privacy policy", href: "/privacy" }, email: defaultEmail, message: defaultMessage, }, } const channelIcons = [Users, LifeBuoy] const field = "h-11 rounded-lg px-3.5 text-[15px] md:text-[15px]" export function ContactForm(props: Partial) { const c = { ...contactFormDefaults, ...props } const f = c.form const email = f.email ?? defaultEmail const message = f.message ?? defaultMessage const t = c.testimonial const initials = t.name .split(" ") .map((w) => w[0]) .join("") .slice(0, 2) return (

{c.kicker}

{c.title}

{c.body}

{ch.label}
{ch.value}
{ch.note}
) })}
